senses.en: A round underground vegetable with brown, red, or yellow skin.

ex.en: I baked a potato and filled it with cheese.
ex.zh: 我烤了一个土豆，并在里面填上奶酪。

ex.en: Potato farming provides an important source of food and income for many rural communities worldwide.
ex.zh: 马铃薯种植为世界各地许多农村社区提供了重要的食物和收入来源。

tip: 复数是 potatoes，词尾加 es。

senses.en: to leave a bus, train, bike or horse

ex.en: We get off the bus at the next stop.
ex.zh: 我们在下一站下车。

ex.en: Please get off your bike at the gate.
ex.zh: 请在门口下车（自行车）。

col: get off the bus｜下公交车
tip: get off 表示“下车/下马”；反义词是 get on（上车）。
scene: Passengers stepping down from a bus at a city bus stop.

senses.en: Entertainment intended to make people laugh.
The humorous quality of a situation or event.

ex.en: We watched a comedy and laughed all evening.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部喜剧，整个晚上都笑个不停。

ex.en: Comedy can encourage audiences to question social attitudes by presenting familiar problems in unexpected and amusing ways.
ex.zh: 喜剧可以用出人意料又有趣的方式呈现常见问题，促使观众反思社会观念。

tip: 指喜剧类型时通常不可数；一部喜剧用a comedy。

senses.en: without waiting or any delay
directly before, after, or next to something
as soon as something happens

ex.en: When the doorbell rang, I immediately opened the door.
ex.zh: 门铃一响，我就立刻打开了门。

ex.en: Schools should respond immediately to safety concerns rather than waiting for a serious incident to occur.
ex.zh: 学校应立即回应安全方面的担忧，而不是等到严重事件发生才采取行动。

tip: 作连词表示“一……就”主要见于英式英语。

senses.en: Belonging to or connected with the person speaking.

ex.en: I left my umbrella beside the front door.
ex.zh: 我把我的伞放在前门旁边了。

ex.en: In my view, cities should prioritise affordable housing rather than invest heavily in prestigious construction projects.
ex.zh: 在我看来，城市应优先提供可负担住房，而非大量投资于彰显声望的建设项目。

col: to my surprise｜令我惊讶的是
tip: my后须接名词；mine可独立使用，表示“我的”。

senses.en: at a time after now or another mentioned time
happening or existing after another time or stage

ex.en: I'll wash the dishes later, after we finish eating.
ex.zh: 等我们吃完饭，我稍后再洗碗。

ex.en: Children who develop strong reading habits often achieve better academic results later in life.
ex.zh: 养成良好阅读习惯的孩子，往往在日后的学习中取得更好的成绩。

col: at a later stage｜在较后的阶段
tip: later表示稍后；latter表示两者中的后者。

senses.en: A group or show featuring acrobats, clowns, and other performers.

ex.en: We watched the circus performers juggle brightly coloured balls.
ex.zh: 我们看着马戏演员抛接色彩鲜艳的球。

ex.en: Modern circus performances can preserve traditional entertainment skills while creating opportunities for artists from diverse backgrounds.
ex.zh: 现代马戏表演既能保留传统娱乐技艺，也能为不同背景的艺术工作者创造机会。

tip: 可指马戏团或表演；复数为circuses。

senses.en: Someone who visits places for pleasure rather than work

ex.en: A tourist asked me how to reach the castle.
ex.zh: 一位游客问我怎么去城堡。

ex.en: Large numbers of tourists support local businesses but can also place pressure on public transport.
ex.zh: 大量游客为当地企业带来生意，但也可能给公共交通造成压力。

tip: tourist通常是名词，在tourist attraction中修饰名词。

senses.en: A device that stores energy and supplies electricity.
A large set of similar things, especially tests or questions.

ex.en: The torch needs a new battery before our trip.
ex.zh: 出发旅行前，这只手电筒需要换一节新电池。

ex.en: Improved battery technology could make electric vehicles more affordable and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 电池技术的进步可以降低电动汽车的价格，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。

col: a battery of tests｜一系列测试
tip: 复数为batteries；a battery of可指一系列测试。

senses.en: A tool with pointed prongs for picking up food
A place where a road or path divides
Divide into separate branches or directions

ex.en: She picked up a carrot with her fork.
ex.zh: 她用餐叉叉起了一块胡萝卜。

ex.en: Where a rural path forks, clear directions can prevent visitors from entering environmentally sensitive areas.
ex.zh: 在乡间小路分叉处提供清晰指引，可以防止游客进入生态敏感区域。

col: a knife and fork｜一副刀叉
a fork in the road｜道路岔口
tip: 道路forks表示分叉；a fork in the road指岔路口。

senses.en: a cold sweet food made from milk and sugar

ex.en: I'd like a chocolate ice cream, please.
ex.zh: 请给我一个巧克力冰淇淋。

ex.en: The children ate ice cream in the summer sun.
ex.zh: 孩子们在夏日阳光下吃冰淇淋。

tip: ice cream 是可数/不可数兼有：an ice cream 一个冰淇淋。
scene: A girl holding a strawberry ice cream cone on a sunny street.

senses.en: After a short time from now or another stated time.

ex.en: Dinner will be ready soon, so wash your hands.
ex.zh: 晚饭很快就好了，去洗手吧。

ex.en: Unless cities improve public transport soon, traffic congestion is likely to become increasingly severe.
ex.zh: 除非城市尽快改善公共交通，否则交通拥堵很可能日益严重。

tip: as soon as引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: a piece of something, or a role in a play

ex.en: This is the best part of the film.
ex.zh: 这是电影最好的部分。

ex.en: She played the main part in the school play.
ex.zh: 她在学校演出中扮演主角。

tip: take part in 是“参加活动”；play a part 是“扮演角色”。
scene: A stage with a girl in a costume taking a bow in the spotlight.

senses.en: Having reached a particular age.
Very old, especially when describing people.

ex.en: The swimming class welcomes children aged six and above.
ex.zh: 这门游泳课欢迎六岁及以上的儿童参加。

ex.en: Public libraries can support children aged five to twelve by providing free reading activities during school holidays.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆可以在学校假期提供免费阅读活动，为五至十二岁的儿童提供支持。

col: aged eighteen and over｜年满十八岁的
tip: 表岁数读/eɪdʒd/；表年迈读/ˈeɪdʒɪd/。

senses.en: a folding cover on a stick protecting against rain or sun
including several different groups, activities, or ideas

ex.en: We shared an umbrella on the walk home.
ex.zh: 走路回家时，我们共撑一把伞。

ex.en: An umbrella organisation can help small charities coordinate their activities and share resources more effectively.
ex.zh: 一个联合组织可以帮助小型慈善机构协调活动，更有效地共享资源。

tip: umbrella term指涵盖多个相关概念的统称。

senses.en: later than an event or time
following the time when something happens
behind or following someone or something

ex.en: We usually take a short walk after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们通常在晚饭后散一小会儿步。

ex.en: After cities improve public transport, more residents may choose to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 城市改善公共交通后，更多居民可能会选择不开车出门。

tip: 介词后接名词或动名词；连词后接完整从句。

senses.en: On different sides of something or surrounding it.
Approximately, rather than exactly.
In or to various places within an area.

ex.en: We sat around the fire and watched the stars.
ex.zh: 我们围坐在火堆旁看星星。

ex.en: Planting trees around school buildings can provide shade and reduce indoor temperatures during hot weather.
ex.zh: 在教学楼周围种树可以提供遮阴，并在炎热天气下降低室内温度。

col: around the corner｜在拐角处；即将到来
tip: around可表大约；around ten即十点或十个左右。

senses.en: Shows who or what performs an action in passive sentences.
Using a particular method or means.
No later than a particular time.

ex.en: This wooden bowl was made by my grandfather.
ex.zh: 这个木碗是我祖父做的。

ex.en: Urban air quality can be improved by expanding public transport and encouraging residents to cycle more often.
ex.zh: 扩大公共交通服务并鼓励居民更多骑车，可以改善城市空气质量。

col: by the end of｜不迟于……结束时
tip: by表示截止时间；until表示状态持续到某时。

senses.en: A female monarch, or the wife of a king.
The main egg-laying female in a social insect colony.
The chess piece that moves any distance in any direction.

ex.en: The queen waved to the crowd from her carriage.
ex.zh: 女王从马车里向人群挥手。

ex.en: In some constitutional monarchies, the queen performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
ex.zh: 在一些君主立宪制国家，女王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。

tip: queen 可指统治国家的女王，也可指国王的妻子。

senses.zh: 祖父母或外祖父母之一
senses.en: The father or mother of one of your parents.

ex.en: Each grandparent brought a homemade dish to our picnic.
ex.zh: 每位祖辈都带了一道自制的菜来参加我们的野餐。

ex.en: A grandparent can provide valuable emotional support when both parents work outside the home.
ex.zh: 当父母都在外工作时，祖父母或外祖父母可以提供宝贵的情感支持。

col: visit your grandparents｜探望祖父母或外祖父母
tip: 单数指一位祖辈；复数可指祖父母或外祖父母。

senses.en: from inside to outside

ex.en: She took a book out of her bag.
ex.zh: 她从包里拿出一本书。

ex.en: He ran out of the room in a hurry.
ex.zh: 他匆忙跑出房间。

tip: out of 表示“从…出来”；反义词是 into（进入）。
scene: A girl taking a book out of her school bag at a desk.

senses.en: Kind, welcoming, and pleasant towards other people.
A sports match played outside an official competition.

ex.en: Our new neighbour is friendly and always waves hello.
ex.zh: 我们的新邻居很友善，总是挥手打招呼。

ex.en: Friendly staff can improve patients' experiences and encourage them to seek medical advice earlier.
ex.zh: 亲切的工作人员能改善患者的就医体验，并鼓励他们更早寻求医疗建议。

col: friendly towards newcomers｜对新来者友好
tip: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词，不是副词。

senses.en: the science of matter, energy, forces, and their interactions

ex.en: Our physics teacher showed us how magnets attract iron.
ex.zh: 我们的物理老师演示了磁铁如何吸引铁。

ex.en: A strong understanding of physics can help engineers develop safer buildings and more efficient transport systems.
ex.zh: 扎实的物理学知识能帮助工程师设计更安全的建筑和更高效的交通系统。

col: the laws of physics｜物理定律
tip: 虽以s结尾，仍作不可数名词，谓语用单数。

senses.en: measuring a large distance from one side to the other
including many different people, things, or possibilities
as far open as possible

ex.en: The sofa will not fit through this wide doorway.
ex.zh: 即使门口这么宽，这张沙发也搬不进去。

ex.en: Universities should offer a wide range of courses to meet students' different interests and career goals.
ex.zh: 大学应提供种类丰富的课程，以满足学生不同的兴趣和职业目标。

col: a wide range of｜各种各样的
tip: wide表示张开程度；widely常表示广泛地。

senses.en: Make someone or something ready for an activity or situation
Make food, a document, or a plan ready for use

ex.en: I prepare my lunch before leaving home each morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上出门前都会准备好午餐。

ex.en: Schools should prepare students for employment by developing practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
ex.zh: 学校应在传授学术知识的同时培养实用技能，让学生为就业做好准备。

col: prepare for an exam｜准备考试
tip: prepare for后接名词；prepare to后接动词原形。

senses.en: to move through the air using wings
to travel in or control an aircraft
a small insect with two wings, often found near food

ex.en: Small birds fly over our garden every morning.
ex.zh: 每天早晨都有小鸟飞过我们的花园。

ex.en: Choosing to travel by train rather than fly can significantly reduce the environmental impact of short journeys.
ex.zh: 短途出行选择火车而非飞机，可以显著减少对环境的影响。

col: a swarm of flies｜一群苍蝇
tip: 动词变化fly–flew–flown；苍蝇复数为flies。

senses.en: a large cup with a handle, usually for hot drinks
to attack someone in public and steal from them

ex.en: I warmed my hands around a mug of tea.
ex.zh: 我双手捧着一大杯茶取暖。

ex.en: Providing reusable mugs in offices can reduce the waste generated by disposable cups each day.
ex.zh: 在办公室提供可重复使用的杯子，可以减少每天由一次性杯子产生的垃圾。

col: a mug of coffee｜一大杯咖啡
tip: mug通常有柄、较大；作动词可指拦路抢劫。

senses.en: Having a low temperature or feeling a lack of warmth.
A common illness causing sneezing, coughing, and a runny nose.
Showing little friendliness, affection, or sympathy.

ex.en: My hands were cold, so I put on gloves.
ex.zh: 我的手很冷，于是戴上了手套。

ex.en: Cold weather can increase household energy costs, placing additional pressure on families with limited incomes.
ex.zh: 寒冷天气会增加家庭能源开支，给收入有限的家庭带来额外压力。

tip: “觉得冷”用be cold；“感冒了”用have a cold。

senses.en: a camera that stores photos electronically

ex.en: She took lots of photos with her digital camera.
ex.zh: 她用数码相机拍了很多照片。

ex.en: A digital camera is easy to use for beginners.
ex.zh: 数码相机对初学者来说很容易使用。

tip: digital camera 存照片用内存卡，不依赖胶卷。
scene: A small silver digital camera in someone's hands at a tourist spot.

senses.en: A coat that keeps your clothes dry in the rain.

ex.en: I grabbed my raincoat before stepping into the rain.
ex.zh: 走进雨中之前，我一把拿起了雨衣。

ex.en: Travellers visiting regions with unpredictable weather should carry a lightweight raincoat to stay comfortable during outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 前往天气多变地区的旅行者应携带轻便雨衣，以便在户外活动时保持舒适。

col: put on a raincoat｜穿上雨衣
tip: 英美英语都使用raincoat，并非仅限美式。

senses.en: Clothing covering the waist and legs, with separate leg sections.

ex.en: These trousers are too long, so I need them shortened.
ex.zh: 这条裤子太长了，我需要把它改短。

ex.en: Some employers require staff to wear formal trousers, while others allow more casual clothing in the workplace.
ex.zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式长裤，另一些则允许员工在工作场所穿得更休闲。

col: a pair of trousers｜一条长裤
tip: 用复数：trousers are；一条用a pair of trousers。

senses.en: A book containing personal accounts of daily events and feelings.
A book used to record appointments and future plans.

ex.en: I write in my diary before going to bed.
ex.zh: 我睡前会写日记。

ex.en: Keeping a learning diary encourages students to reflect on their progress and identify difficulties.
ex.zh: 坚持写学习日记能鼓励学生反思自己的进步并发现困难。

tip: diary是日记，dairy是乳制品；注意字母顺序。

senses.en: used for direction, receiving, or with verbs

ex.en: We walked to the park.
ex.zh: 我们走到公园。

ex.en: I want to learn English.
ex.zh: 我想学英语。

tip: to 表方向“到…”；也用于动词不定式 to do。
scene: A path leading from houses to a green park.

senses.en: to keep something in your hands or arms
to organise an event or meeting
to have enough space for something or someone

ex.en: Could you hold my bag while I tie my shoes?
ex.zh: 我系鞋带时，你能帮我拿一下包吗？

ex.en: Local councils should hold public meetings before making major changes to transport services.
ex.zh: 地方议会在对交通服务作出重大调整之前，应当召开公众会议。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为held；举行会议用hold。

senses.en: the teacher in charge of a school

ex.en: The headteacher gave a speech at the school assembly.
ex.zh: 校长在全校集会上讲话。

ex.en: Our headteacher knows every student by name.
ex.zh: 我们的校长知道每个学生的名字。

tip: headteacher 是英式说法，美式常说 principal。
scene: A headteacher in a suit speaking to students in a school hall.

senses.en: someone who grows crops or raises animals on a farm

ex.en: The farmer feeds her chickens before the sun rises.
ex.zh: 这位农民在日出前给她的鸡喂食。

ex.en: Small farmers need reliable access to water and affordable technology to maintain production during dry periods.
ex.zh: 小农户需要可靠的水源和负担得起的技术，才能在干旱期间维持生产。

tip: farmer指人，farm指农场，farming指农业生产。

senses.en: used to show purpose, who receives, or duration

ex.en: This gift is for you.
ex.zh: 这份礼物是给你的。

ex.en: We stayed in London for three days.
ex.zh: 我们在伦敦待了三天。

col: for a long time｜很长时间
tip: for 后接时间段表示“持续多久”；since 后接时间点表示“自从”。
scene: A wrapped gift with a ribbon being handed to a smiling girl.

senses.en: a young cat

ex.en: The kitten is playing with a ball of wool.
ex.zh: 小猫在玩毛线球。

ex.en: We adopted a kitten from the animal shelter.
ex.zh: 我们从动物收容所领养了一只小猫。

tip: kitten 是小猫；成年猫是 cat。
scene: A tiny orange kitten playing with a ball of wool on a carpet.

senses.en: A drink made from roasted beans, or the beans and powder.

ex.en: I drink coffee with milk before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 我上班出门前会喝一杯加奶咖啡。

ex.en: Rising temperatures may threaten coffee production, affecting the incomes of farmers in several developing countries.
ex.zh: 气温上升可能威胁咖啡生产，影响一些发展中国家农民的收入。

col: a cup of coffee｜一杯咖啡
tip: 通常不可数；点单时two coffees指两杯咖啡。

senses.en: to stop a machine or light working

ex.en: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
ex.zh: 离开时请关灯。

ex.en: He turned off the TV and went to bed.
ex.zh: 他关掉电视上床睡觉。

tip: turn off 与 switch off 同义；反义 turn on。
scene: A hand switching off a lamp in a bedroom.

senses.en: A covering for the foot, usually with a firm sole.

ex.en: There was a small stone inside my shoe.
ex.zh: 我的鞋里有一颗小石子。

ex.en: Comfortable shoes are essential for workers who spend most of their working day standing.
ex.zh: 对于工作时大部分时间都站着的员工来说，舒适的鞋子至关重要。

tip: 一双鞋用a pair of shoes，shoe为可数名词。

senses.en: From or relating to a country other than your own.
Present where it does not naturally belong.
Unfamiliar to someone or inconsistent with something.

ex.en: My sister enjoys learning foreign languages in her spare time.
ex.zh: 我姐姐喜欢在空闲时间学习外语。

ex.en: Foreign investment can create jobs, but governments should ensure that local communities also benefit from economic growth.
ex.zh: 外国投资可以创造就业机会，但政府应确保当地社区也能从经济增长中受益。

tip: foreign to可指对某人陌生，或与某事不相符。

senses.en: a bicycle or, informally, a motorcycle
to travel somewhere by bicycle

ex.en: I locked my bike outside the corner shop.
ex.zh: 我把自行车锁在街角商店外面。

ex.en: Encouraging commuters to travel by bike could reduce urban congestion and improve public health.
ex.zh: 鼓励通勤者骑自行车出行可以缓解城市拥堵，并改善公众健康。

tip: by bike不加冠词；ride a bike中的a不能省。

senses.en: used when people do something to themselves

ex.en: They made the dinner themselves.
ex.zh: 晚餐是他们自己做的。

ex.en: The children enjoyed themselves at the party.
ex.zh: 孩子们在聚会上玩得很开心。

tip: by themselves 表示“独自”；enjoy oneself 是“玩得开心”。
scene: Children laughing and enjoying themselves at a birthday party.

senses.en: Small in size or young in age.
Not much; almost no amount of something.
Only slightly or not very much.

ex.en: A little bird landed on our kitchen windowsill.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟落在我们厨房的窗台上。

ex.en: Many rural schools have little access to digital resources, which can widen existing educational inequalities.
ex.zh: 许多农村学校很难获得数字资源，这可能加剧现有的教育不平等。

tip: little加不可数名词表示几乎没有；a little表示有一点。

senses.en: A narrow board with small wheels, ridden standing up.
To move or perform tricks on a skateboard.

ex.en: He carried his skateboard home when the rain started.
ex.zh: 开始下雨时，他抱着滑板回家了。

ex.en: Providing dedicated areas for skateboard users can encourage physical activity while reducing conflicts with pedestrians in public spaces.
ex.zh: 为滑板使用者提供专用区域，可以鼓励体育活动，同时减少公共空间中与行人的冲突。

tip: skateboard无扶手；scooter通常有扶手。

senses.en: a wide road designed for fast travel over long distances

ex.en: We left the motorway and stopped for lunch.
ex.zh: 我们驶离高速公路，停下来吃午饭。

ex.en: Building a new motorway may reduce journey times, but it can also damage nearby wildlife habitats.
ex.zh: 修建新的高速公路可能缩短行程时间，但也会破坏附近的野生动物栖息地。

col: join the motorway｜驶入高速公路
tip: 主要用于英式英语；美式常用freeway。

senses.en: Having a taste like sugar or honey.
Kind, gentle, or thoughtful.
A small piece of sugary food eaten as a treat.

ex.en: These strawberries are sweet enough to eat without sugar.
ex.zh: 这些草莓已经够甜了，不加糖也好吃。

ex.en: Reducing children's consumption of sweet drinks may lower their risk of tooth decay and excessive weight gain.
ex.zh: 减少儿童含糖饮料的摄入，可能降低他们蛀牙和体重过度增长的风险。

tip: 糖果英式常用sweets，美式常用candy。

senses.en: an unpleasant physical feeling caused by injury or illness
strong emotional suffering caused by loss or distress
to cause someone emotional suffering

ex.en: I felt a sharp pain in my left ankle.
ex.zh: 我的左脚踝感到一阵剧痛。

ex.en: Regular exercise may reduce back pain among office workers who remain seated for long periods.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可能减轻长时间久坐的办公室职员的背痛。

tip: 泛指疼痛常不可数；具体一阵疼痛可用a pain。

senses.en: near something

ex.en: My house is close to the station.
ex.zh: 我家离车站很近。

ex.en: The children sat close to the fire to get warm.
ex.zh: 孩子们靠近火坐着取暖。

tip: close to 与 near 意思相近；far from 是它的反义表达。
scene: A small house standing right next to a train station building.

senses.en: The part of the day between midnight and noon

ex.en: I open the curtains every morning and water my plants.
ex.zh: 我每天早晨拉开窗帘，给植物浇水。

ex.en: Schools that start later in the morning may help teenagers get enough sleep and concentrate better.
ex.zh: 上午较晚上课的学校可能有助于青少年获得充足睡眠，更好地集中注意力。

col: in the morning｜在早晨；在上午
on Monday morning｜在星期一早上
tip: 泛指用in the morning；具体某天早上用on。

senses.en: a large desert animal with one or two humps

ex.en: We rode camels in the desert.
ex.zh: 我们在沙漠里骑了骆驼。

ex.en: The camel has two humps on its back.
ex.zh: 这头骆驼背上有两个驼峰。

tip: 骆驼的驼峰叫 hump；单峰驼是 dromedary。
scene: A camel standing in a sandy desert with dunes in the background.

senses.en: A unit of distance equal to approximately 1.61 kilometres.

ex.en: The nearest swimming pool is only a mile away.
ex.zh: 最近的游泳池只有一英里远。

ex.en: Replacing short car journeys with walking even one mile could improve public health and reduce emissions.
ex.zh: 用步行替代短途驾车，哪怕只走一英里，也能改善公众健康并减少排放。

tip: 英里是距离单位；mile可数，复数加s。

senses.en: Having a lot of wind.

ex.en: It was too windy to eat lunch outside today.
ex.zh: 今天风太大，没法在外面吃午饭。

ex.en: Windy coastal regions can generate renewable electricity, although turbines must be positioned carefully to protect wildlife.
ex.zh: 多风的沿海地区可以生产可再生电力，但风力涡轮机必须谨慎选址，以保护野生动物。

col: a windy day｜刮大风的一天
tip: 天气义读/ˈwɪndi/；描述道路蜿蜒通常用winding。

senses.en: In or towards a place that is not inside.
Beyond the boundaries or limits of something.
Located on the outer part or coming from elsewhere.

ex.en: The children played outside while their parents prepared lunch.
ex.zh: 父母准备午饭时，孩子们在外面玩耍。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for students to learn outside the classroom through practical activities and community projects.
ex.zh: 学校应通过实践活动和社区项目，为学生提供课堂之外的学习机会。

tip: 后接地点用介词 outside；单独使用可作副词。

senses.en: in or to a place that is not specified
approximately, when used before an amount or range

ex.en: I left my keys somewhere near the sofa.
ex.zh: 我把钥匙落在沙发附近的某个地方了。

ex.en: Young people need somewhere affordable to live before they can fully participate in the local economy.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要有负担得起的住所，才能充分参与当地的经济活动。

tip: 形容词放后面：somewhere quiet；前面通常不加to。

senses.en: ahead of; before something in position

ex.en: The school is in front of the park.
ex.zh: 学校在公园前面。

ex.en: She stood in front of the class and spoke.
ex.zh: 她站在全班面前发言。

tip: in front of 指“在…前面”；反义词是 behind（在…后面）。
scene: A school building standing in front of a green park with trees.

senses.en: a sea animal with a soft body and eight arms

ex.en: An octopus squeezed through a narrow gap between rocks.
ex.zh: 一只章鱼从岩石间狭窄的缝隙挤了过去。

ex.en: Research into octopus behaviour has revealed remarkable learning abilities, challenging traditional assumptions about intelligence in marine animals.
ex.zh: 对章鱼行为的研究揭示了其非凡的学习能力，挑战了有关海洋动物智力的传统假设。

col: a giant octopus｜一只巨型章鱼
tip: 常用复数是octopuses；腕通常称arms。

senses.en: food made from flour and water, shaped and usually boiled

ex.en: We cooked pasta with fresh tomatoes and mushrooms.
ex.zh: 我们用新鲜番茄和蘑菇做了意大利面。

ex.en: School canteens can serve wholegrain pasta with vegetables to provide affordable meals with more fibre.
ex.zh: 学校食堂可以供应搭配蔬菜的全麦意大利面，提供价格实惠、膳食纤维更多的餐食。

tip: 不可数；一份意面可说a bowl of pasta。

senses.en: in or to which place

ex.en: Where do you live?
ex.zh: 你住在哪里？

ex.en: Do you know where the library is?
ex.zh: 你知道图书馆在哪里吗？

tip: where 用于询问地点。
scene: A tourist looking at a map and asking where a place is.

senses.en: having the darkest colour, like coal
the darkest colour
relating to people with ancestry from sub-Saharan Africa

ex.en: She wore a black coat and bright yellow boots.
ex.zh: 她穿着黑色外套和亮黄色靴子。

ex.en: Black roofs absorb more sunlight than pale roofs, potentially increasing the energy needed for cooling.
ex.zh: 黑色屋顶比浅色屋顶吸收更多阳光，可能增加制冷所需的能源。

tip: 指族裔时常大写为Black；避免用作单数名词称人。

senses.en: a game where teams throw a ball through raised hoops
the large round ball used in this game

ex.en: We play basketball at the park after school.
ex.zh: 放学后，我们在公园打篮球。

ex.en: Team sports such as basketball help young people develop cooperation skills while improving their physical fitness.
ex.zh: 篮球等团队运动有助于年轻人培养协作能力，同时增强体质。

tip: play basketball不加冠词；指一个球用a basketball。

senses.en: the natural object that moves around Earth
a natural object that moves around a planet

ex.en: The moon rose slowly above the trees behind our house.
ex.zh: 月亮在我们屋后的树梢上缓缓升起。

ex.en: Research on the moon may help scientists understand how Earth and other rocky planets formed.
ex.zh: 对月球的研究可能帮助科学家了解地球和其他岩石行星的形成过程。

col: the surface of the moon｜月球表面
tip: 指地球的月亮通常用the moon；其他行星的卫星可数。

senses.en: A large wild cat with dark stripes on orange fur

ex.en: The tiger rested in the shade beside a pool.
ex.zh: 那只老虎在水池旁的阴凉处休息。

ex.en: Protecting tiger habitats also helps conserve other species that share the same forest ecosystems.
ex.zh: 保护老虎栖息地也有助于保护同一森林生态系统中的其他物种。

tip: 可数名词；一只老虎用a tiger。

senses.en: A table used for studying, writing, or office work
A counter where people receive information or services

ex.en: I keep my pencils in the top desk drawer.
ex.zh: 我把铅笔放在书桌最上面的抽屉里。

ex.en: Providing every student with a suitable desk can improve comfort and concentration in the classroom.
ex.zh: 为每位学生提供合适的课桌可以提高课堂上的舒适度和专注度。

col: sit at a desk｜坐在书桌前
tip: 在书桌前用at a desk，不用on a desk。

senses.en: a machine that plays DVDs

ex.en: The DVD player is under the television.
ex.zh: DVD播放机在电视机下面。

ex.en: Put the film into the DVD player.
ex.zh: 把电影光盘放进DVD播放机里。

tip: DVD player 用来播放 DVD 光盘。
scene: A DVD player on a shelf under a television with a disc sliding in.

senses.en: of the kind already mentioned or being described
used to emphasise a quality or degree before a noun

ex.en: It was such a lovely day that we ate outside.
ex.zh: 天气如此宜人，我们就在外面吃了饭。

ex.en: Many cities face severe traffic congestion, and such problems require coordinated investment in public transport.
ex.zh: 许多城市面临严重的交通拥堵，这类问题需要统筹公共交通投资来解决。

tip: 单数可数名词前用such a/an；so后直接接形容词。

senses.en: a liquid fuel used in cars and other engines

ex.en: We stopped for petrol before driving into the mountains.
ex.zh: 开车进山前，我们停车加了汽油。

ex.en: Higher petrol prices may encourage commuters to use public transport rather than drive to work.
ex.zh: 汽油价格上涨可能促使通勤者乘坐公共交通，而不是开车上班。

col: run out of petrol｜汽油用尽
tip: 不可数名词；英式用petrol，美式用gasoline或gas。

senses.en: Give someone information or describe something in words.
Instruct someone to do something.
Recognise a difference or know something from available evidence.

ex.en: Please tell me what happened at school today.
ex.zh: 请告诉我今天在学校发生了什么。

ex.en: Schools should tell parents how personal information about their children is collected and stored.
ex.zh: 学校应告知家长，孩子的个人信息是如何被收集和保存的。

col: tell someone to do something｜吩咐某人做某事
tip: tell常直接接人；say接人时通常用to。

senses.en: the time when people work

ex.en: The shop's working hours are nine to six.
ex.zh: 这家店的工作时间是九点到六点。

ex.en: Please call us during working hours.
ex.zh: 请在上班时间给我们打电话。

tip: working hours 是工作时间，即上班时段。
scene: An office clock showing working hours with a schedule on the wall.

senses.en: A series of lessons about a particular subject.
The route something follows or the way events develop.
One part of a meal served separately from other parts.

ex.en: I joined a cooking course at the community centre.
ex.zh: 我报名参加了社区中心的烹饪课程。

ex.en: Universities should design each course to combine theoretical knowledge with practical skills relevant to future employment.
ex.zh: 大学应在设计每门课程时，将理论知识与未来就业所需的实用技能相结合。

tip: course 是整门课程；lesson 是其中的一节课。

senses.en: a male ruler who usually inherits his position

ex.en: The king waved to the crowd from his carriage.
ex.zh: 国王从马车上向人群挥手。

ex.en: In some countries, the king performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
ex.zh: 在一些国家，国王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。

col: the king's reign｜国王的统治时期
tip: king指男性君主；queen可指女王或王后。

senses.en: something that belongs to us

ex.en: This garden is ours.
ex.zh: 这个花园是我们的。

ex.en: Their house is bigger than ours.
ex.zh: 他们的房子比我们的大。

tip: ours 是名词性物主代词，后面不接名词。
scene: Two children playing in their own garden with a swing.

senses.en: an area of sand or small stones beside water
to bring a boat onto a shore

ex.en: We collected smooth stones on the beach after breakfast.
ex.zh: 早餐后，我们在海滩上捡了些光滑的石头。

ex.en: Local authorities should protect beaches from plastic waste while ensuring that tourism benefits nearby communities.
ex.zh: 地方政府应保护海滩免受塑料垃圾污染，同时确保旅游业惠及附近社区。

tip: 在海滩上用on the beach；shore泛指岸边。

senses.en: At a lower position, level, or amount than something.
In a lower place or later in a piece of writing.

ex.en: Our cat sleeps on the shelf below the window.
ex.zh: 我们的猫睡在窗户下方的架子上。

ex.en: Households with incomes below the national average may struggle to afford adequate heating during winter.
ex.zh: 收入低于全国平均水平的家庭可能难以负担冬季充足供暖的费用。

tip: below强调位置或数值较低，不一定在正下方。

senses.en: A way in which people or things are not alike
A disagreement between people or groups
The amount by which one quantity exceeds another

ex.en: The main difference between these jackets is their weight.
ex.zh: 这两件夹克的主要区别在于重量。

ex.en: Understanding cultural differences can help international students adapt more successfully to life in a new country.
ex.zh: 了解文化差异有助于留学生更顺利地适应新国家的生活。

tip: 比较两者用the difference between A and B。

senses.en: a woman who is married to someone

ex.en: His wife packed sandwiches for their afternoon walk.
ex.zh: 他的妻子为他们下午的散步准备了三明治。

ex.en: A husband and wife may share childcare responsibilities more equally when both have flexible working hours.
ex.zh: 如果夫妻双方的工作时间都很灵活，他们就可能更平等地分担育儿责任。

tip: 复数为wives；spouse指配偶，不限定性别。

senses.en: In, at, or towards that place.
Used before a verb to introduce something that exists.

ex.en: Leave your muddy boots there, beside the back door.
ex.zh: 把你沾满泥的靴子放在那儿，就在后门旁边。

ex.en: There are several practical ways for cities to reduce waste without increasing household expenses.
ex.zh: 城市可以采取几种切实可行的办法，在不增加家庭开支的情况下减少垃圾。

tip: there表地点或引出存在句；别与their混淆。

senses.en: to want something to happen and believe it may happen
a feeling that something wanted may happen

ex.en: I hope the rain stops before our picnic.
ex.zh: 我希望野餐前雨能停。

ex.en: Many graduates hope to find meaningful employment that allows them to contribute positively to society.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生希望找到有意义的工作，使自己能够为社会作出积极贡献。

col: hope to do something｜希望做某事
hope for the best｜抱最好的希望
in the hope of｜怀着……的希望
tip: 可说hope to do，不说hope sb to do。

senses.en: someone who leads people and explains places they visit
a book or resource giving useful information or instructions
to show someone the way or help them decide

ex.en: Our guide led us through the narrow market streets.
ex.zh: 导游带我们穿过市场里狭窄的街道。

ex.en: Teachers should guide students towards reliable sources rather than simply provide answers to every question.
ex.zh: 教师应引导学生寻找可靠的信息来源，而不是直接给出每个问题的答案。

col: guide someone through｜引导某人完成
guided tour｜有导游带领的游览
tip: 指南用a guide to；指导某人完成用guide someone through。

senses.en: a usually hard, shiny material that conducts heat and electricity

ex.en: The metal handle felt cold against my fingers.
ex.zh: 金属把手摸起来冰凉。

ex.en: Recycling metal reduces the demand for mining and can significantly lower energy consumption in manufacturing.
ex.zh: 回收金属可以减少采矿需求，并显著降低制造业的能源消耗。

tip: 泛指材料时不可数；指金属种类时可数。

senses.en: to control a vehicle and make it move
to cause something to develop or someone to act
a car journey, strong motivation, or a computer storage device

ex.en: Can you drive me to the station after breakfast?
ex.zh: 早饭后你能开车送我去车站吗？

ex.en: Consumer demand can drive innovation by encouraging companies to develop products that use fewer natural resources.
ex.zh: 消费者需求可以鼓励企业开发消耗更少自然资源的产品，从而推动创新。

col: drive economic growth｜推动经济增长
go for a drive｜开车兜风
tip: 不规则变化：drive—drove—driven；送某人用drive sb to。

senses.en: a cold drink made with lemons, sugar and water

ex.en: She made fresh lemonade for the picnic.
ex.zh: 她为野餐做了新鲜的柠檬水。

ex.en: Can I have a glass of lemonade, please?
ex.zh: 请给我一杯柠檬水好吗？

col: a glass of lemonade｜一杯柠檬水
tip: lemonade 是柠檬饮料；英式常指气泡柠檬汽水。
scene: A glass jug of lemonade with lemons on a picnic blanket.

senses.en: The front of the head, including eyes, nose, and mouth.
To encounter or deal with a difficult situation.
To look or point in a particular direction.

ex.en: He washed his face before sitting down for breakfast.
ex.zh: 他洗了脸才坐下来吃早餐。

ex.en: Many coastal cities face increasing risks from flooding as sea levels rise and extreme weather becomes more frequent.
ex.zh: 随着海平面上升和极端天气日益频繁，许多沿海城市面临越来越大的洪水风险。

tip: 面对困难可说face difficulties或be faced with difficulties。

senses.en: a round, deep container used for food or liquids
to roll a bowling ball or deliver a cricket ball

ex.en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
ex.zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。

ex.en: Serving meals in smaller bowls may help people control portions and reduce unnecessary food waste.
ex.zh: 用较小的碗盛饭可能有助于人们控制食量，减少不必要的食物浪费。

tip: a bowl of表示“一碗”；bowling指保龄球运动。

senses.en: relating to formal Western music, such as symphonies and operas
relating to ancient Greece or Rome and their culture
based on established theories rather than newer approaches

ex.en: My sister listens to classical music while cooking.
ex.zh: 我姐姐做饭时听古典音乐。

ex.en: Studying classical architecture helps students understand how ancient design principles continue to influence modern public buildings.
ex.zh: 研究古典建筑有助于学生理解古代设计原则如何持续影响现代公共建筑。

tip: 古典音乐用classical；经典作品常用classic。

senses.en: a person who is shopping

ex.en: The shoppers filled the supermarket on Saturday.
ex.zh: 周六超市里挤满了购物者。

ex.en: Shoppers can park free for two hours.
ex.zh: 购物者可免费停车两小时。

tip: shopper 指正在购物的人；customer 是顾客。
scene: A shopper with carrier bags walking through a busy supermarket.

senses.en: a female person or animal already mentioned

ex.en: She is my sister.
ex.zh: 她是我妹妹。

ex.en: Where is Anna? She is in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 安娜在哪？她在厨房里。

tip: she 是主格；宾格 her，物主代词 hers。
scene: A girl waving from a kitchen doorway as someone asks where she is.

senses.en: any day from Monday to Friday

ex.en: The swimming pool is quieter on weekday mornings.
ex.zh: 游泳池在工作日的早晨比较安静。

ex.en: Extending library opening hours on weekdays would benefit students who work during the day.
ex.zh: 延长图书馆工作日的开放时间，将有利于白天工作的学生。

tip: 指周一至周五，不保证当天实际上需要上班。

senses.en: someone whose job is to help people learn

ex.en: Our teacher brought a plant into class today.
ex.zh: 我们的老师今天带了一株植物来上课。

ex.en: A well-trained teacher can adapt classroom activities to support students with different learning needs and abilities.
ex.zh: 训练有素的教师能够调整课堂活动，以帮助学习需求和能力各不相同的学生。

tip: 英语中称呼老师通常用Mr、Ms等加姓，不直接喊Teacher。

senses.en: food that is made and served quickly

ex.en: We had fast food for lunch because we were in a hurry.
ex.zh: 因为赶时间，我们午饭吃了快餐。

ex.en: Eating too much fast food is not healthy.
ex.zh: 吃太多快餐不健康。

tip: 常见的 fast food 有汉堡、炸鸡、薯条等。
scene: A takeaway counter with burgers and fries in paper wrappers.

senses.en: a polite greeting used in the evening

ex.en: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen.
ex.zh: 女士们先生们，晚上好。

ex.en: We said good evening to the hotel manager.
ex.zh: 我们向酒店经理问晚上好。

tip: good evening 用于傍晚及晚上的问候；晚安说 good night。
scene: A hotel receptionist greeting a guest at the front desk in the evening.

senses.en: a hard surface built for vehicles to travel along
a way of reaching a particular result or situation

ex.en: Look both ways before you cross the road.
ex.zh: 过马路前要向两边看。

ex.en: Investment in road maintenance can improve public safety and reduce transport costs for local businesses.
ex.zh: 投资道路养护能提高公共安全水平，并降低当地企业的运输成本。

col: the road to recovery｜康复之路
tip: on the road常指在旅途中；road to可比喻通往某结果的途径。

senses.en: a public message promoting a product, service, or opportunity

ex.en: An ad for cooking classes caught my attention yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天，一则烹饪课广告吸引了我的注意。

ex.en: Online ads can influence consumer choices by presenting products that match users' browsing habits and interests.
ex.zh: 网络广告通过展示符合用户浏览习惯和兴趣的产品，可以影响消费者的选择。

tip: ad是advertisement的非正式缩写，是可数名词。

senses.en: an entrance area or passage connecting rooms in a building
a large room or building used for public gatherings
a building where university students live

ex.en: Please leave your wet shoes in the hall.
ex.zh: 请把湿鞋留在门厅里。

ex.en: The community hall provides an affordable space where residents can attend classes and organise local events.
ex.zh: 社区会堂为居民提供了一个价格实惠的场所，供他们上课和组织当地活动。

col: halls of residence｜大学学生宿舍
tip: 英式英语中，大学宿舍常称halls或halls of residence。

senses.en: the sport of riding a horse

ex.en: She goes riding every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 她每周六早上去骑马。

ex.en: Riding is a popular sport in the countryside.
ex.zh: 骑马是乡村很受欢迎的运动。

tip: riding 指骑马运动；horse-riding 也是常见说法。
scene: A girl riding a brown horse across a green field.

senses.en: Making something easier to do or understand.
Willing to help other people.

ex.en: Your map was helpful when we explored the village.
ex.zh: 我们游览村庄时，你的地图帮了大忙。

ex.en: Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.
ex.zh: 对于正在学习如何组织学术论文思路的学生来说，清晰的反馈尤其有帮助。

col: find something helpful｜觉得某物有帮助
tip: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。

senses.en: An intelligent aquatic mammal with a long snout and curved fin.

ex.en: A dolphin leapt beside our boat early this morning.
ex.zh: 今天一大早，一只海豚在我们的船边跃出水面。

ex.en: Underwater noise from shipping can disrupt dolphin communication and make it harder for these animals to find food.
ex.zh: 船运产生的水下噪声会干扰海豚交流，使它们更难找到食物。

col: a pod of dolphins｜一群海豚
tip: 海豚是哺乳动物；一群海豚可说a pod of dolphins。

senses.en: Having a high temperature.
Having a strong taste that burns your mouth.
Attracting a lot of interest or discussion.

ex.en: Be careful; the soup is still very hot.
ex.zh: 小心，汤还很烫。

ex.en: As summers become increasingly hot, cities need more shaded public spaces to protect residents from heat.
ex.zh: 随着夏季越来越炎热，城市需要更多有遮阴设施的公共空间来保护居民免受高温影响。

tip: 形容食物时可指“烫”或“辣”，需结合语境。

senses.en: a place where animals are kept for people to see

ex.en: We saw lions and monkeys at the zoo.
ex.zh: 我们在动物园看到了狮子和猴子。

ex.en: The zoo is closed on Mondays.
ex.zh: 动物园周一闭园。

tip: zoo 是动物园；go to the zoo 去动物园。
scene: A zoo entrance with a lion enclosure and children looking in.
